title: DGX Spark, cluster of 4
body: Does anyone have a first-hand experience with four Sparks cluster, and how much of an upgrade is it comparing to just two considering the available models ? While there's plenty of noise for the smaller models (Qwen) and our older king DeepSeek V4F, the scene in the upper class of the prosumer hardware, software stacks, available LLMs and their actual real-world performance – isn't really covered as well.
